content.title: Dunkin free coffee on April 1, 2026 with April Fools code
content.text: POP-CULTUREDunkin free coffee on April 1, 2026: The April Fools code to use Charles CurtisFor The WinApril 1, 2026, 7:16 a.m. ET0:22/0:43Keep WatchingIt sounds like a cruel April Fools Day prank on April 1, 2026, but nope! By all accounts, this one is true.If you're a Dunkin' rewards member, you can get a free cup of coffee on Wednesday, April 1, 2026. How is that possible? Simply open the app and type in this code: STILLNOTAJOKE.There you have it! Go get your free coffee if you're a Dunkin' rewards member and laugh about how you thought it might have been a prank.
